statuses.todo: ready for the runner once its depends and gate allow
statuses.build: the runner is on it, or an earlier pull request was closed without merging
statuses.review: built, checked and in a pull request or merged; waits for Eddie to set done
statuses.waiting: needs a ruling: Eddie, Donnie or HLR (see needs_you and owner)
statuses.ruled: Eddie or Donnie ruled it; the record carries the line

rules.order: Within a step, the runner takes items in the order listed; legal-delete first.

items.name: Engine 0.6.0: delete the legal regime, keep product facts with sources
items.intent: Remove lib/claims.js’s legal regime and brand-pack/legal-ledger.json’s role from the HLR bundle: the signer, needs_legal and blocked, the disclaimer row, counsel placeholders, and every branch of brief_lint, copy_lint, paid_lint, social_lint and route_findings that reads them. never_say (the brief) and prohibited_patterns (voice) stay. Product facts that lived in the ledger move to products.json with their sources; the ledger file goes to _archive/. Update references/pack-contract.md, the SKILL.md files, the tests, REVIEW.md (section 1 Not for, section 2 check 3, section 4 tier 3, the never-ships list keeps "invented figure, claim, price, quote or review" as sourcing) and build/emdash_baseline.txt where regenerated outputs change.
acceptance: no needs_legal, blocked, signer or ledger reference remains in the bundle or the pack (grep is the test)
every fact that was a ledger row is in products.json with a source
bash build/checks.sh passes with 0.6.0 as the newest bundle; bundle-report-0.6.0.md follows the 0.5.3 report’s sections
REVIEW.md updated and a fresh-context review with no open blocker
items.note: 2026-10-31, runner: built into engine 0.6.0 (outputs/step-3-bundle/bundle-report-0.6.0.md); the grep test is clean, the ledger is archived under _archive/brand-pack/, its facts are in products.json _meta.brand_facts; checks.sh PASS; the fresh-context review (acceptance 4) has not run.

items.name: Engine 0.6.0: retire routes, slates, the judge, verify, options-board, squad-run, web and social copy from the HLR bundle
items.intent: Move the retired skills and their references out of the bundle to _archive/ (never deleted), keep every lint and script the crew reuses (brief_lint, copy_lint, paid_lint, fit_check, slot_lint, tokens_build, preflight), update the registry, README and BUNDLE.md, and the skill descriptions.
acceptance: the bundle lists only brief-intake, email-copy, paid-ad-copy, design-system and asset-production, or their crew successors
every reused script still has its tests and they pass
bundle-report-0.6.0.md names what was retired and where it went
items.note: 2026-10-31, runner: built into engine 0.6.0; the bundle lists brief-intake, email-copy, paid-ad-copy, design-system and asset-production; the retired skills are under _archive/engine-0.5.3-retired/ with a README; 18 test files, 466 checks pass; the fresh-context review has not run.

items.intent: crew/README.md (how a co-worker is defined: prompt.md with explicit inputs and outputs, schema.json, check command), crew/run.py (Python 3.9+, standard library plus the openai package: base URL, model and key from environment; reads the pack and the brief; runs the co-workers in order; writes JSON outputs; validates each against its schema; runs each check CLI; stops at the human pick), a fixture brief and a --dry-run mode that uses canned outputs so the pipeline runs with no key. Claude-specific files (SKILL.md) become thin pointers to crew/.

tests under crew/tests/ cover the schema validation and the stop at the human pick
